page.overview:
Who is Father Michael?

Father Michael is a fictional character who appears in several of Fantasy Flight Games' Arkham Horror Files series of Cthulhu Mythos-related games and fiction. He is the pastor at Arkham's South Church, and works alongside investigator character Sister Mary.

Father Michael first appeared as a Blight card in the Arkham Horror Second Edition expansion set The King in Yellow, although he was mentioned on Sister Mary's Investigator card from the Core Set.

In the novella by Richard Lee Byers, Father Michael made a brief appearance when the protagonists, Professors Norman Withers and Claus Schmidt, visited South Church as part of their research.
